_readme: OpenRouter pay-per-token rates, $/1M tokens, for the Cohort 1 open-weight frontier models.

These are the PINNED-ENDPOINT rates, not OpenRouter's list rates. Every cohort run pins one provider (--only-provider --no-fallback), and the host that serves a request sets the price. The list rate is the cheapest or default route and does NOT match the pinned host: z-ai/glm-5.3 lists at 0.05/7.00 (Wafer) but Z.AI charges 1.40/4.40, and deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash lists at 0.30/1.20 but its pinned host DeepInfra charges 0.14/0.42. Using the list rate would understate or overstate the chart's costUsd.
Each row names the `provider` it was priced for, so a costUsd is auditable against which host served the run as well as the as-of date.

deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash is pinned to DeepInfra, not DeepSeek: the first-party DeepSeek endpoint is excluded by this account's OpenRouter privacy setting (it trains on prompts), which returns HTTP 404 0-endpoints on a pinned request. DeepInfra serves the same model at 0.14/0.42 fp8.

Source: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/<id>/endpoints (the pinned endpoint's `pricing` block, per-token, multiplied by 1e6). Captured 2026-10-05; rates drift, so the as-of date and the provider name are the audit anchors.

Shape mirrors config/opencode-go-rates.json so the same rateFor() lookup path serves both. Each entry has tiers[]; a pinned endpoint has one rate, so there is exactly one tier per model here (maxPromptTokens: null).

The runner stamps pricing: 'pay-per-token' and costUsd from this table when an OpenRouter model resolves a rate and the run carries usage. computeCost() checks config.model.price first (a per-model override in config/models.json) and falls back to this table.
costUsd = (prompt_tokens * inputPer1M + completion_tokens * outputPer1M) / 1e6, rounded to 6dp.

Re-derive a row: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/<id>/endpoints, find the row whose provider_name matches the pin, read its pricing block. Do not type a number you have no source for, and do not copy the model-level list rate.
